content.doc_md:
HTML tables can have headers for each column or row, or for many columns/rows. Table headers are defined withthelements. Eachthelement represents a table cell. To use the first column as table headers, define the first cell in each row as aelement: By default, table headers are bold and centered: To left-align the table headers, use the CSStext-alignproperty: You can have a header that spans over two or more columns. To do this, use thecolspanattribute on theelement: You can add a caption that serves as a heading for the entire table. To add a caption to a table, use thetag: ### Code Snippets ```
Firstname Lastname Age
Jill Smith 50
Eve Jackson 94
---
Firstname Jill Eve
Lastname Smith Jackson
Age 94 50
--- th { text-align: left; } ---

---

```
